identity.title: [v0.92][CI][coverage][defect] Classify mechanical compile-fallout without weakening changed-source coverage

values.task_boundary: Issue #295 coverage-tooling classification only; no #258 product mutation, no parent completion, and no optional hosted expansion.
deliverables: Fail-closed exact unified-diff classifier for governed import-only and argument-pass-through fallout
Per-hunk compile proof and per-owner/API behavioral proof enforcement
Machine receipt containing file, hunk, token, owner, tests, and rationale
Focused positive and negative regression fixtures
PVF classification and preserved coverage authority documentation
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Accept only exact import-only or argument-pass-through diffs to already governed APIs
AC-2: Require compile proof for every accepted hunk
AC-3: Require mapped behavioral proof for every owning API path including EstablishedRuntimeAuthority
AC-4: Emit a machine receipt with file, hunk, token, owner, tests, and rationale
AC-5: Reject semantic, predicate, branch, state, error, and unmapped-file changes
AC-6: Preserve the fail-closed 80 percent changed-source coverage gate for non-exempt source
AC-7: Introduce no blanket path allowlist
AC-8: Introduce no nightly or full-coverage exclusion
AC-9: Keep PR-fast evidence explicitly non-authoritative
AC-10: Keep #258 republication blocked until #295 is terminal and ancestral
repo_inputs: issue #258 transport/core.rs diff as read-only fixture
non_goals: Weakening the 80 percent changed-source coverage gate
Cloud, paid hosted, or optional job expansion
